# origincloud_network_route_table_associations (Data Source)

Lists a subnet's route table associations: none or one.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (String) The project whose route table associations to list.
- `subnet` (String) The subnet whose route table associations to list.
- `zone` (String) The zone whose route table associations to list.

### Read-Only

- `route_table_associations` (Attributes List) The route table associations listed, from every page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--route_table_associations))

<a id="nestedatt--route_table_associations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `route_table_associations`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) The association's resource name. Its last segment is the route table's id.
- `route_table` (String) The route table the subnet uses, in the subnet's VPC.
